ward_summary.measure_note: Bicyclist-involved crash COUNTS by Chicago ward, 2021-01-01 onward (Chicago's full data goes back to 2015; we used a window matching DC's in length, not because we separately confirmed Chicago's pre-2021 reporting consistency the way DC's was checked -- a deliberate consistency choice, not an equivalent claim). NOT exposure-adjusted on its own -- see ward_exposure for that. Chicago's crash data has no e-bike-specific flag either, same gap as every other source in this project. helmet_used/helmet_not_used and in_bike_lane are DIRECTLY police-reported fields -- more reliable than an estimate, but still subject to whatever the reporting officer observed and recorded at the scene. near_mapped_bike_lane is the SEPARATE OSM-proximity estimate also used for DC (within ~30m of a mapped cycleway) -- it can disagree with in_bike_lane (e.g. a real lane exists but isn't mapped on OSM yet, or the officer's 'in bike lane' call was about a lane too new/minor to be in OSM). Both are shown, not reconciled into one number.

ward_exposure.measure_note: NOT a true risk-per-rider rate, same caveat as DC: the numerator (crashes) includes ALL cyclists, the denominator (Divvy trips) only Divvy's fleet. Read as 'crash activity relative to Divvy activity', not 'risk per cyclist'.
